name: DoraTama! ~You Ryuu Leila no Seichou Nikki~
original_name: ドラたま! ～幼竜ライラの成長日記～
source:
Two women climbed into a dragon's nest, heroine Tina and magical girl Clis.
However, after they successfully beat the dragon, they discovered its baby egg.

As they bickered about what to do, it hatched before them, a darling baby...

"Daddeeeeee!" it cried to Tina. Daddy?! 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE068833.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
两名女性爬进了龙巢，她们分别是女主角蒂娜和魔法少女克莉丝。
然而，成功击败巨龙后，她们发现了一枚幼龙蛋。

正当两人为如何处置它争执不休时，蛋在她们面前孵化了，一只惹人怜爱的小龙宝宝破壳而出……

“爸——爸——！”它冲着蒂娜叫道。爸爸？！
